question: How much will Nvidia's stock price returns exceed Apple's in these biweekly periods of Q3 2026? (Sep 21 - Oct 2)

calls.reasoning: Quantity is a 10-trading-day relative return (Sep 21-Oct 2, 2026), a near-martingale: the honest answer is a near-zero center and a wide, fat-tailed spread. Reference class gives conflicting drifts - since Jan 2024 NVDA beat AAPL by ~+1.3pp per 10-day window, but 2026 YTD reverses that to ~-0.8pp per window, and the last six weeks' overlapping windows median about -4pp. I weight the conditional (2026/current-regime) evidence more than the unconditional and set the median at -0.6pp, a small tilt only: a 25bp Fed hike priced at ~83% for Sep 16 plus 10y yields near 5% plus a fresh AI-slowdown narrative (Amodei essay, circular-financing worries, chips down 5-8% on Sep 14) hurt the higher-beta, higher-multiple name more, while short-horizon cross-sectional reversal after NVDA's ~8% six-session drawdown cuts the other way. Dispersion dominates: current realized spread vol (NVDA/AAPL correlation has gone negative in this rotation, which widens the difference) implies ~7pp SD over the window, so 10-90 spans roughly -8 to +7. No NVDA or AAPL earnings inside the window; quarter-end Sep 30 is. No prediction market matches this contract - the Polymarket year-end market-cap-leader book (NVDA 79%, ~$6.8M volume) differs on horizon, threshold and resolution source, so I recorded it without blending. Main uncertainty I could not resolve: whether the Anthropic IPO (NVDA reportedly anchoring up to $10B) prices inside the window, which is the largest single identifiable two-sided catalyst.
